summary: Frontend-only verification of the wavy-note overhaul + auto-gen per-difficulty chart building + results screen + editor regression. ALL FOUR SCENARIOS PASS. (1) Wavy visual: Home → Library → On this device → Voco Warmup → Normal → Generate & play Normal renders gameplay after the 3-2-1 countdown with NO crash / no red screen; wavy notes appear as a single clean glowing RIBBON that smoothly snakes across multiple lanes (captured as a clear S-curve trace in normal_frame_02/03) — no distorted/clipped/rotated blob. Pause → Exit song routes back to /library without crash. (2) Auto-gen per difficulty: Easy and Hard both build charts and enter gameplay with no stuck 'Building' state. Easy is visibly sparse (1–2 falling notes per frame) and Hard is visibly dense (5–8+ falling notes per frame) — clear density delta confirms difficulty scaling. (3) Results screen: after the Hard run naturally completed, /results rendered with results-summary-card, results-starlites-card, judgment-breakdown-card, results-replay-button, results-edit-chart-button, results-continue-button all present. Body shows 'Run Complete', accuracy %, MAX COMBO, STARLITES EARNED +50, judgment breakdown (Perfect/Great/Good/Miss). Live stars use half-star tiers (star-half icons visible in the HUD during gameplay). (4) Editor regression: Home → Editor → Choose a track → On this device → Voco Warmup → Skip tutorial → Record → tap board twice → Save — 'Chart saved ✓' toast appears, header shows '2 NOTES · CUSTOM CHART'. No functional issues discovered in the four flows under test.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/game.tsx L41-58 wavePathData: builds smooth quadratic-Bezier path from recorded path or a tapered sine fallback; ribbon rendered as 3 stacked <Path> strokes (glow-halo + main + white core) — this is what produces the clean glowing ribbon look observed in gameplay.

/app/frontend/app/game.tsx L118-136 ActiveHoldBar early-returns null for wavy notes (isWavy) so the previous distorted active-hold bar is correctly suppressed for wavy sustains — the falling ribbon + lit receptor lane guide the trace instead. Behavior matches the request that this awkward bar was removed.

/app/frontend/src/game/chartEngine.ts config table: Easy density 0.55/holdEvery 4/waveEvery 8 vs Hard 0.74/holdEvery 3/waveEvery 6/chord 0.12. Onset-based path additionally uses keepFrac Easy 0.22 vs Hard 0.7 and minGap Easy 0.5 vs Hard 0.2. Density delta observed in gameplay matches this table.

/app/frontend/src/game/chartEngine.ts L20-28 wavePath uses swing=0.32 (~2.5 lanes peak-to-peak) so a generated wave is guaranteed to cross lanes — matches the request that the wave 'must trace across lanes'.

/app/frontend/app/game.tsx L279-285 countdown effect has a 2.5s forceStart fallback that guarantees the game begins even if audio loading stalls; verified: gameplay-screen was visible with notes after ~6.5s in every attempted run.
game.tsx is 498 lines — under the 700-line splitting threshold but dense; not flagged as an issue.
